findings.note: Introduced by Woods. Would put on the ballot a repeal of Article I, Section 23 of the Missouri Constitution (the strict-scrutiny gun-rights clause) and replace it with text letting counties, St. Louis and Kansas City regulate possessing, carrying or transferring firearms by ordinance, including permits (fee capped at cost, valid up to five years, with background-check lookups), with exemptions for police, judges and armed guards.
subjects: permits to carry or possess guns
